verdict.rationale: AMD publishes 288GB HBM3E capacity and 8TB/s bandwidth for MI355X, far exceeding what's needed for 70B-class quantized inference, and documents vLLM/SGLang inference stacks for deployment; independent analysis corroborates the memory capacity/bandwidth lead over competing accelerators. Missing for 10: no direct hands-on benchmark or published throughput numbers specifically for a 70B model at a given quantization on this GPU.
